sections.description: List of section names to include in the configuration. Each section groups related rules.

rules.description: List of rules to apply. Each rule defines a pattern, color, and action for log filtering. Must include 'section' field to specify which section the rule belongs to (must be in 'sections').

rules.items.description: Rule definition for log filtering. All fields are required unless otherwise noted.

rules.items.section.description: Name of the section this rule belongs to. Must be present in 'sections'.

rules.items.pattern.description: Pattern to match. Use /pattern/ for regular expressions, or "pattern" for literal string matching.

rules.items.is_regex.description: If true, enclose pattern in /.../ for regex matching. If false, enclose in "..." for literal matching.

rules.items.color.description: Color specification. Valid values include: 'bold', 'underline', 'black', 'red', 'green', 'yellow', 'blue', 'magenta', 'cyan', 'white', 'bold red', 'underline on green', 'rgb200 on grey4', etc. See manpage for full list.

rules.items.action.description: Action to perform on match. Must be one of: 'line' (color entire line), 'match' (color only the matched part), 'suppress' (omit line from output), or 'blank' (replace line with blank).
